TE Leo Karlberg presented the report of the Commission to Adjudicate the Complaint of RE Truman B. Swain, Jr., et al. against the Presbytery of Eastern Carolina, i.e. that the complainants did not appear and therefore according to BCO 42-10 the case is judged

artifacts.synopsis: A session's complaint against Eastern Carolina Presbytery for lifting from the table a matter concerning the church was abandoned because neither the complainant nor counsel appeared before the Commission within two days, despite public notice and a recess, and no satisfactory explanation was given. The Commission also confirmed and adopted the SCJB's interim advice on Reference 8: six questions were properly declined as redressable by complaint or review and control, while the seventh only required referring the applicant to the BCO.
